usage_examples.mt: L-effiċjenza tal-magna l-ġdida naqqset l-ispejjeż tal-elettriku.
usage_examples.en: The efficiency of the new machine reduced electricity costs.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu l-istess valur, ammont u status bħal oġġett jew persuna oħra (equal).

usage_examples.mt: Żewġ partijiet egwali maqtugħin mil-tavla.
usage_examples.en: Two equal parts cut from the board.

definitions.text_mt: L-istat u l-prinċipju ta' ugwaljanza fid-drittijiet (equality).

usage_examples.mt: L-egwalità bejn iċ-ċittadini kollha hija mnaqqxa fil-kostituzzjoni.
usage_examples.en: Equality among all citizens is inscribed in the constitution.

definitions.text_mt: Għamilt żewġ ammonti jew riżultati jkunu l-istess fit-tul jew f'punti (equalize).

usage_examples.mt: Egwalizza l-punteġġ matul it-tieni nofs tal-partita.
usage_examples.en: He equalized the score during the second half of the match.

definitions.text_mt: Ugwaljanza u prinċipju ta' opportunitajiet l-istess, egwalità.

usage_examples.mt: L-egwaljanza soċjali hija fundamentali għall-paċi.
usage_examples.en: Social equality is fundamental for peace.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod ugwali f'partijiet l-istess għal kulħadd (equally).

usage_examples.mt: Qassmu l-profitt egwalment bejn l-investituri kollha.
usage_examples.en: They distributed the profit equally among all investors.

definitions.text_mt: Element kimiku radjoattiv maħluq artifiċjalment b'simbolu Es u numru atomiku 99.

usage_examples.mt: L-einsteinju huwa element rari użat fir-riċerka nukleari.
usage_examples.en: Einsteinium is a rare element used in nuclear research.

definitions.text_mt: Ksejt u neħħejt id-dawl ta' pjaneta oħra fil-viżjoni astronomika (eclipse).

usage_examples.mt: Il-qamar eklissa x-xemx għal ftit minuti f'nofs il-ġurnata.
usage_examples.en: The moon eclipsed the sun for a few minutes at midday.

definitions.text_mt: Avveniment astronomiku fejn dawl ta meħtieġ ta' xemx jew qamar jgħosfor (eclipse).

usage_examples.mt: L-eklissi solari kienet viżibbli mir-reġjun kollu.
usage_examples.en: The solar eclipse was visible from the entire region.

definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni għall-pjan u r-rotta solari fl-astronomija (ecliptic).

usage_examples.mt: Pjan eklittiku li fuqu jersqu l-pjaneti madwar ix-xemx.
usage_examples.en: An ecliptic plane on which planets move around the sun.

definitions.text_mt: Ix-xjenza li tuda r-relazzjonijiet bejn l-organiżmi u l-ambjent tagħhom (ecology).

usage_examples.mt: L-ekoloġija tal-gżejjer Maltin hija unika u protetta.
usage_examples.en: The ecology of the Maltese islands is unique and protected.

definitions.text_mt: Li ma jagħmilx ħsara lill-ambjent u li jipproteġi n-natura (ecological).

usage_examples.mt: Bini b'disinn ekoloġiku li juża l-enerġija mis-solari.
usage_examples.en: A building with ecological design using solar energy.

definitions.text_mt: Is-sistema ta' produzzjoni, kummerċ u użu tal-flus f'pajjiż (economy).
Ix-xjenza u l-istudju dwar il-merkat finanzjarju (economics).
Ħaġa jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal economy.

usage_examples.mt: L-ekonomija nazzjonali rreġistrat tkabbir b'saħħtu.
usage_examples.en: The national economy registered healthy growth.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod li jiffranka l-flus u mir-rigward finanzjarju (economically).

usage_examples.mt: Il-proġett kien meqjus bħala vijabbli ekonomikament.
usage_examples.en: The project was considered economically viable.

definitions.text_mt: Li ma jeħtieġx spejjeż kbar u li jiffranka l-flus (economical).
Li ikun relatat mat-tmexxija finanzjarja ta' stat (economic).

usage_examples.mt: Għażla ekonomika li għenet biex inaqqsu l-ispejjeż tal-familja.
usage_examples.en: An economical choice that helped reduce family expenses.

definitions.text_mt: Professjonist u speċjalista li janalizza l-ekonomija u l-merkati (economist).

usage_examples.mt: L-ekonomista ppreżenta analiżi dettaljata dwar ir-riformi.
usage_examples.en: The economist presented a detailed analysis of the reforms.

etymology_chain.definition: to economize, to save money [ with su ‘on’ ] [auxiliary avere ]

definitions.text_mt: Naqqast l-ispejjeż u użajt il-fondi b'kawtela u prudenza (economize).

usage_examples.mt: Ekonomizzaw fir-riżorsi matul il-perjodu ta' diffikultà.
usage_examples.en: They economized on resources during the period of difficulty.

definitions.text_mt: Ir-reverberazzjoni u r-repetizzjoni ta' ħoss nieżel lura mill-blat jew bini (echo).

usage_examples.mt: L-eku ta' vuċitu nstema' mal-għar kollu.
usage_examples.en: The echo of his voice was heard throughout the cave.

definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fl-Aritmetika ta' t'Isfel b'kapitali Quito fil-kontinent Amerikan.

usage_examples.mt: Quito hija l-kapitali tal-Ekwador.
usage_examples.en: Quito is the capital of Ecuador.

definitions.text_mt: Stqarrija matematika fejn żewġ espressjonijiet huma ugwali bil-valur (equation).

usage_examples.mt: Solva l-ekwazzjoni matematika fuq il-bord.
usage_examples.en: He solved the mathematical equation on the board.

definitions.text_en: to balance, to equilibrate, to counterbalance
definitions.text_mt: Stabbilejt u żammejt bilanċ u piż ugwali bejn żewġ partijiet (balance).

usage_examples.mt: Ekwilibra it-tagħbija fuq żewġ naħat tat-trakk.
usage_examples.en: He balanced the load on both sides of the truck.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess ta' stabbiliment u żamma ta' bilanċ (balancing).

usage_examples.mt: L-ekwilibrazzjoni tar-riżorsi kienet meħtieġa għas-sigurtà.
usage_examples.en: The balancing of resources was necessary for safety.

etymology_chain.definition: equilibrium, balance ( state of being balanced )

definitions.text_mt: Stat ta' stabbiltà u bilanċ sħiħ fil-piż u fl-emozzjonijiet (equilibrium).

usage_examples.mt: Zamm l-ekwilibriju tiegħu u ma waqax mill-ħajt.
usage_examples.en: He maintained his equilibrium and didn't fall from the wall.

definitions.text_mt: Artist ta' ċirku li jimxi fuq ħabel imdendel bi preċiżjoni (tightrope walker).

usage_examples.mt: L-ekwilibrist għamel prestazzjoni impressjonanti f'għoli kbir.
usage_examples.en: The tightrope walker gave an impressive performance at great height.

definitions.text_mt: Artist ta' ċirku li jimxi fuq ħabel imdendel bi preċiżjoni (tightrope walker).

usage_examples.mt: L-ekwilibrista daħal fiċ-ċirku fost l-applaws tal-udjenza.
usage_examples.en: The tightrope walker entered the ring amid the audience's applause.

definitions.text_mt: Poġġejt u rrikonoxxejt żewġ oġġetti jew status bħala ugwali (equalize / equate).

usage_examples.mt: Ekwipara l-kwalifiki barranin ma' dawk nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: He equated foreign qualifications with national ones.

definitions.text_mt: Li jista' jiġi rrikonoxxut bħala ekwivalenti f'valur jew grad (equivalent).

usage_examples.mt: Grad akkademiku ekwiparabbli ma' dak lokali.
usage_examples.en: An academic degree equivalent to the local one.

definitions.text_mt: Zidt u spjegajt b'aktar reqqa u dettalji pjan jew idea preċedenti (elaborate).

usage_examples.mt: Elabora fuq il-proposta prinċipali matul il-preżentazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He elaborated on the main proposal during the presentation.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess ta' tħejjija u spjegazzjoni dettaljata ta' proġett (elaboration).

usage_examples.mt: L-elaborazzjoni tal-pjanijiet ħadet bosta xhur ta' ħidma.
usage_examples.en: The elaboration of plans took several months of work.

definitions.text_mt: Forma tal-plurali wara numri żgħar għall-kelma elf (thousands).

usage_examples.mt: Tliet elef persuna attendew għall-marċ uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: Three thousand people attended the official march.

definitions.text_en: to list, to enumerate, to inventory
definitions.text_mt: Mktabt u rreġistrajt l-oġġetti jew il-kliem f'lista ordnata (list / enumerate).

usage_examples.mt: Elenka l-punti prinċipali dwar it-tiswija tad-dar.
usage_examples.en: He listed the main points regarding the house repair.

definitions.text_mt: Lista, katalgu jew inventarju ordnat ta' oġġetti jew dokumenti (list / catalog).

usage_examples.mt: Poġġa r-riċevuta fl-elenku tar-riżorsi uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: He placed the receipt in the inventory of official resources.

definitions.text_mt: Kariga jew suġġett magħżul b'votazzjoni u mhux b'obbligu (elective).

usage_examples.mt: Bord elettiv magħżul mir-residenti kollha.
usage_examples.en: An elective board chosen by all residents.

definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni għall-elezzjonijiet u l-votazzjoni nazzjonali (electoral).

usage_examples.mt: Kummissjoni elettorali li tmexxi l-proċess tal-votazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: An electoral commission managing the voting process.

definitions.text_mt: Il-korp sħiħ ta' ċittadini li għandhom id-dritt li jivvotaw f'pajjiż (electorate).

usage_examples.mt: L-elettorat ivvota bil-konċentrazzjoni sħiħa tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: The electorate voted with its full focus.

definitions.text_mt: Li jaħdem jew jiġi pprovdut mill-enerġija tal-elettriku (electric).
Li għandu proprjetà jew kwalità ta' electrical.

usage_examples.mt: Vettura elettrika li ma tipproduċix emissjonijiet fit-triq.
usage_examples.en: An electric vehicle producing no emissions on the road.

definitions.text_mt: Il-forza u l-kurrent ta' enerġija użat fil-bini u fit-teknoloġija (electricity).

usage_examples.mt: Ntefa l-elettriku mar-raħal kollu wara l-maltempata.
usage_examples.en: Electricity went off in the entire village after the storm.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess ta' provvista u introduzzjoni tal-elettriku f'sistema (electrification).

usage_examples.mt: L-elettrizzazzjoni tal-linji tal-ferrovija bdiet f'Jannar.
usage_examples.en: The electrification of the railway lines began in January.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ħaddiem u l-artjan speċjalizat fit-tiswija tas-sistemi elettriċi (electrician).

usage_examples.mt: L-elettriċista rranġa l-wajers kollha fid-dar.
usage_examples.en: The electrician repaired all the wires in the house.

definitions.text_mt: Forza u enerġija stabbilita permezz tal-kurrent elettriku (electricity).

usage_examples.mt: L-elettriċità ntefiet matul il-maltempata fil-belt.
usage_examples.en: The electricity went off during the storm in the city.

definitions.text_mt: Akkumulazzjoni ta meħtieġ ta' kurrent elettriku fuq uċuħ ta' oġġetti (static electricity).

usage_examples.mt: L-elettriċità statika kkawżat daqqa żgħira meta mess it-tubu.
usage_examples.en: Static electricity caused a small shock when he touched the pipe.

definitions.text_mt: Pprovdejt u ddaħħalt l-elettriku f'bini jew vettura (electrify).

usage_examples.mt: Elettriċizzaw ir-raħal kollu u pprovdew id-dwal.
usage_examples.en: They electrified the whole village and provided lights.

definitions.text_mt: Li jaħdem jew ikun relatat mill-forzi tal-elettriku u l-manjetiżmu (electromagnetic).

usage_examples.mt: Mewġ elettromanjetiku użat fil-komunikazzjoni u fit-televiżjoni.
usage_examples.en: Electromagnetic waves used in communication and television.

definitions.text_mt: Branka fiżika li tuda r-relazzjonijiet bejn il-kurrenti elettriċi u l-kampi manjetiċi.

usage_examples.mt: L-elettromanjetiżmu huwa prinċipju fundamentali fil-fiżika.
usage_examples.en: Electromagnetism is a fundamental principle in physics.

definitions.text_mt: Apparat jew sistema li tuża l-komponenti u r-raġġi tal-elettronika (electronic).

usage_examples.mt: Biegħet kompjuter elettroniku fil-ħanut lokali.
usage_examples.en: She sold an electronic computer in the local shop.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li għandha id-dritt u r-reġistrazzjoni biex tivvota fl-elezzjonijiet (elector).

usage_examples.mt: Kull elettur ppreżenta d-dokument qabel ma vvota.
usage_examples.en: Every elector presented the document before voting.

definitions.text_en: to raise, to lift, to elevate
definitions.text_mt: Għollejt u rreferejt oġġett jew status f'post aktar għoli (raise / elevate).
Għamilt u ġibt ferħ kbir fi spirtu ta' persuna.

usage_examples.mt: Eleva l-grad tiegħu wara suċċess fix-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: He elevated his rank after success at work.

definitions.text_mt: L-att li tgħolli jew il-proċess ta' żieda fil-livell jew fil-grad.

usage_examples.mt: L-elevament tal-istruttura sar b'makkinarju tqil.
usage_examples.en: The raising of the structure took place with heavy machinery.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u r-rit uffiċjali ta' għoljien ta' oġġett sagru jew livell għoli fil-bini (elevation).
Ħaġa jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal sequestration.

usage_examples.mt: L-elevazzjoni tal-bini kienet viżibbli mill-pjazza.
usage_examples.en: The elevation of the building was visible from the square.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess fejn iċ-ċittadini jivvotaw biex jagħżlu r-rappreżentanti tagħhom (election).

usage_examples.mt: L-elezzjoni ġenerali saret f'atmosfera pacifiċi fil-pajjiż.
usage_examples.en: The general election took place in a peaceful atmosphere in the country.

etymology_chain.definition: eligibility, right to stand for election, electability

definitions.text_mt: Il-kundizzjoni legali li jkollok l-kwalifiki biex tipparteċipa f'kompetizzjoni (eligibility).

usage_examples.mt: Iċċekkjaw l-eleġibbilità tiegħu qabel ma aċċettaw il-kandidatura.
usage_examples.en: They checked his eligibility before accepting the candidacy.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew applikazzjoni li għandha r-rekwiżiti kollha biex tiġi magħżula (eligible).

usage_examples.mt: Kien kandidat eleġibbli għas-soluzzjoni finanzjarja.
usage_examples.en: He was an eligible candidate for the financial solution.

definitions.text_mt: Għażilt u rreġistrajt persuna fil-kariga permezz tal-voti fl-elezzjoni (elect).

usage_examples.mt: Eleġġew s-sindku l-ġdid mill-membri kollha.
usage_examples.en: They elected the new mayor from all members.

definitions.text_mt: In-numru li huwa ppreżentat minn 10 darbiet mitt u bbażat fuq 1,000 (thousand).

usage_examples.mt: Ħallas elf ewro biex jikseb l-oġġett antik.
usage_examples.en: He paid one thousand euros to acquire the ancient item.

definitions.text_mt: Numru enormi li huwa ugwali għal miljun f'kalkoli (million).

usage_examples.mt: Elf l-eluf ta' nies żaru l-fiera nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: A million people visited the national fair.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont kbir ta' miljuni, elf l-eluf.

usage_examples.mt: Investew elf l-elufijiet fil-proġett l-ġdid.
usage_examples.en: They invested millions in the new project.

definitions.text_mt: Il-forma ddoppjata u d-duwal tal-kelma elf li tfisser 2,000 (two thousand).

usage_examples.mt: Elfejn resident iffirmaw il-petizzjoni nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: Two thousand residents signed the national petition.

definitions.text_mt: Neħħejt, ħassart u qtajt oġġett jew persuna minn lista uffiċjali jew proċess (eliminate).
Jagħmel azzjoni relatata ma' to kill.

usage_examples.mt: Elimina r-riskji kollha qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: He eliminated all risks before starting work.

definitions.text_mt: Kompitu jew rotta maħsuba biex tneħħi l-kandidati mhux xierqa (eliminatory).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet partida eliminatorja fit-tieni fażi tas-sport.
usage_examples.en: It was an eliminatory match in the second stage of the sport.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess ta' tneħħija jew tħassir sħiħ ta' rwol jew oġġett (elimination).

usage_examples.mt: L-eliminazzjoni tat-tnaqqis ġabet riżultati tajba.
usage_examples.en: The elimination of reduction brought good results.

etymology_chain.definition: eligibility, right to stand for election, electability

definitions.text_mt: Il-kundizzjoni legali li jkollok l-kwalifiki biex tipparteċipa f'kompetizzjoni (eligibility).

usage_examples.mt: Ikkonfermaw l-eliġibbilità tagħha għall-boroż ta' studju.
usage_examples.en: They confirmed her eligibility for the scholarship.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew applikazzjoni li għandha r-rekwiżiti kollha biex tiġi magħżula (eligible).

usage_examples.mt: Studenti eliġibbli biex japplikaw għall-kors.
usage_examples.en: Eligible students to apply for the course.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu r-relazzjoni mal-teorija fejn ix-xemx tinsab fiċ-ċentru (heliocentric).

usage_examples.mt: Mudell eljoċentriku mwaqqaf minn Koperniku fl-astronomija.
usage_examples.en: A heliocentric model established by Copernicus in astronomy.

definitions.text_mt: Teorija astronomika fejn ix-xemx tinsab fiċ-ċentru tas-sistema solari.

usage_examples.mt: L-eljoċentriżmu biddel il-viżjoni xjentifika tal-univers.
usage_examples.en: Heliocentrism changed the scientific view of the universe.

definitions.text_mt: Element kimiku gassuż nieqes mill-kulur u mir-riħa b'simbolu He u numru atomiku 2.

usage_examples.mt: Mlew il-ballun bl-elju biex jiela' fl-arja.
usage_examples.en: They filled the balloon with helium so it would rise in the air.

definitions.text_mt: Tħassir u ommissjoni fil-grammatika ta' kelma f'sentenza (ellipsis).
Figura ġeometrika tonda iżda estiża f'forma ta meħtieġ ta' bajda (ellipse).

usage_examples.mt: Pinġa ellissi fuq il-bord b'pinna.
usage_examples.en: He drew an ellipse on the board with a pen.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu l-forma kurvata u estiża ta' ellissi (ecliptical / elliptical).

usage_examples.mt: Rotta ellittika segwita mill-pjaneti madwar ix-xemx.
usage_examples.en: An elliptical route followed by planets around the sun.

definitions.text_mt: Għodda u kpiepel iebes tal-metall użat biex jipproteġi r-ras fil-gwerra jew fis-sewqan (helmet).

usage_examples.mt: Libes l-elmu qabel ma ppoġġa ruħu fuq il-mutur.
usage_examples.en: He put on the helmet before placing himself on the motorbike.

definitions.text_mt: Għamilt tifħir kbir u diskors pożittiv dwar l-azzjonijiet ta' xi ħadd (eulogize).

usage_examples.mt: Eloġja l-impenn u l-bżulija tal-ħaddiema kollha.
usage_examples.en: He eulogized the commitment and hard work of all workers.

definitions.text_mt: Diskors jew bini ta' tifħir pubbliku għal persuna jew għemil.

usage_examples.mt: Qraw eloġju solenni matul iċ-ċerimonja tat-tmiem.
usage_examples.en: They read a solemn eulogy during the closing ceremony.

etymology_chain.definition: to evade, to elude, to dodge, to sidestep

definitions.text_mt: Ħarbt, evitajt u rriżolvejjt ruħek bil-kawtela mir-regoli jew mill-periklu (elude / evade).

usage_examples.mt: Eluda l-għassa tal-pulizija u sparixxa fit-toroq.
usage_examples.en: He eluded the police watch and disappeared in the streets.

definitions.text_en: plural of elf: thousands (a vague number far beyond 1000)
definitions.text_mt: Plurali tal-kelma elf u użata għal numru miftuħ u kbir ta' eluf.

usage_examples.mt: Eluf ta meħtieġ ta' nies inġabru fil-pjazza prinċipali.
usage_examples.en: Thousands of people gathered in the main square.

definitions.text_mt: Spjegajt u tajt dawl ċar fuq mistoqsija jew problema kumplessa (elucidate).

usage_examples.mt: Eluċida l-punti kollha mhux ċari fil-kuntratt.
usage_examples.en: He elucidated all unclear points in the contract.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess ta' spjegazzjoni u tħejjija ċara ta meħtieġ ta' kunċett (elucidation).

usage_examples.mt: L-eluċidazzjoni tat-teorija nstabet xierqa ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The elucidation of the theory was found very appropriate.

definitions.text_mt: Ħriġt u xext radjazzjoni, dawl, riħa jew liġi uffiċjali minn sors (emanate).

usage_examples.mt: Id-dawl emana miċ-ċentru tal-kristall.
usage_examples.en: Light emanated from the centre of the crystal.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess fejn dawl jew liġi toħroġ minn sors uffiċjali (emanation).

usage_examples.mt: L-emanazzjoni tal-liġi ġdida saret mill-parlament.
usage_examples.en: The emanation of the new law was made by parliament.

definitions.text_mt: Liberajt u tajt ir-riżorsi u d-drittijiet sħaħ lil persuna li kienet maħkuma (emancipate).

usage_examples.mt: Emanċipaw lill-ħaddiema kollha u tawhom id-drittijiet.
usage_examples.en: They emancipated all workers and gave them rights.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess ta' kisba ta' libertà u drittijiet legali fi soċjetà.

usage_examples.mt: L-emanċipazzjoni tan-nisa kienet pass kbir storiku.
usage_examples.en: The emancipation of women was a major historical step.

etymology_chain.definition: to marginalize, to isolate, to exclude from a community

definitions.text_en: to marginalize, to isolate, to exclude from a community
definitions.text_mt: Poġġejt u ksirt ir-rabta billi tbiegħed u teskludi persuna mill-komunità (marginalize).

usage_examples.mt: Emarġinaw lill-barrani b'mod mhux xieraq.
usage_examples.en: They marginalized the foreigner inappropriately.

etymology_chain.definition: inflection of emendare: third-person singular present indicative second-person singular imperative

definitions.text_mt: Bidla, korrezzjoni u żieda uffiċjali applikata f'liġi jew f'dokument (amendment).

usage_examples.mt: Ippreżentaw emenda l-ġdida għall-abbozz ta' liġi.
usage_examples.en: They presented a new amendment to the draft law.

definitions.text_mt: Biddilt u rranġajt d-dettalji jew ir-regoli f'test biex tkun korretta (amend).

usage_examples.mt: Emenda l-paragrafu minħabba ż-żball fl-ismijiet.
usage_examples.en: He amended the paragraph due to the error in names.

definitions.text_mt: Dokument jew liġi li tista' tiġi mmodifikata b'emenda uffiċjali (amendable).

usage_examples.mt: Klawżola emendabbli skont il-qbil tal-partijiet.
usage_examples.en: An amendable clause according to the agreement of the parties.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess uffiċjali ta' emenda fir-regolamenti, emenda.

usage_examples.mt: L-emendament kien approvat mill-maġġoranza tad-deputati.
usage_examples.en: The amendment was approved by the majority of deputies.

definitions.text_mt: Korrezzjoni jew reviżjoni bil-miktub f'test, emendament.

usage_examples.mt: L-emendazzjoni tat-test saret mill-editur.
usage_examples.en: The emendation of the text was made by the editor.

etymology_chain.definition: to emit, to give out, to give off

definitions.text_mt: Ħriġt u xext radjazzjoni, dawl jew talba uffiċjali mill-uffiċċju (emit).

usage_examples.mt: Emetta dawl blu permezz tal-lampa.
usage_examples.en: It emitted blue light by means of the lamp.

definitions.text_mt: Ħallejt pajjiżek biex tmur tgħix u taħdem f'pajjiż ieħor (emigrate).

usage_examples.mt: Emigraw lejn l-Awstralja fl-aħħar tas-seklu l-ieħor.
usage_examples.en: They emigrated to Australia at the end of last century.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li titlaq minn pajjiżha biex tagħmel residenza fil-barrani (emigrant).

usage_examples.mt: L-emigrant kiteb ittra lura lil familtu f'Malta.
usage_examples.en: The emigrant wrote a letter back to his family in Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Il-moviment u l-proċess ta meħtieġ ta meħtieġ ta' nies li jitalqu minn pajjiżhom.

usage_examples.mt: L-emigrazzjoni żdiedet matul is-snin ħamsin.
usage_examples.en: Emigration increased during the fifties.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna famuża, rikonoxxuta u bil-prestiġju fl-istudji tagħha (eminent).

usage_examples.mt: Professur eminenti li għamel diskors fil-konferenza.
usage_examples.en: An eminent professor who gave a speech at the conference.

definitions.text_en: United Arab Emirates (a country in West Asia in the Middle East)
definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fil-Lvant Nofsani magħmul minn sebgħat emirati b'kapitali f'Abu Dhabi.

usage_examples.mt: Abu Dhabi hija l-kapitali tal-Emirati Għarab Magħquda.
usage_examples.en: Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates.

definitions.text_mt: Mibgħut u uffiċjal rappreżentanti mibgħut f'missjoni segrieta jew diplomatika (emissary).

usage_examples.mt: L-emissarju ppreżenta d-dokument lill-gvern barrani.
usage_examples.en: The emissary presented the document to the foreign government.

definitions.text_mt: Li jġib u jaffettwa l-emozzjonijiet minnufih fil-bniedem (emotive).

usage_examples.mt: Argument emotiv li stabbilixxa interess kbir fis-sala.
usage_examples.en: An emotive argument that established great interest in the hall.

etymology_chain.definition: to bring (someone) to feel a strong emotion; to move, to touch

definitions.text_en: to move, to arouse the feelings
definitions.text_mt: Għamilt u ġibt emozzjonijiet sħaħ u ferħ jew emozzjoni fil-qalb ta' xi ħadd (move).

usage_examples.mt: L-aħbar emozzjonat lill-familja kollha wara xhur ta' stennija.
usage_examples.en: The news moved the entire family after months of waiting.

definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni għas-sentimenti u l-emozzjonijiet interni tal-bniedem (emotional).

usage_examples.mt: Reazzjoni emozzjonali għar-riżultat tal-konkors.
usage_examples.en: An emotional reaction to the contest result.

definitions.text_mt: It-tendenza li tuża jew li tesperjenza l-emozzjonijiet b'mod eċċessiv.

usage_examples.mt: L-emozzjonaliżmu tiegħu ma ppermettiex deċiżjonijiet loġiċi.
usage_examples.en: His emotionalism didn't allow for logical decisions.

definitions.text_mt: Min-naħa tal-emozzjonijiet u s-sentimenti fil-bniedem (emotionally).

usage_examples.mt: Kien konness emozzjonalment max-xogħol tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He was emotionally connected to his work.

definitions.text_mt: Li jġib emozzjoni, eċċitament u spirtu pożittiv fis-sala (moving / exciting).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet film emozzjonanti ħafna li ferħet lil kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: It was a very moving film that brought joy to everyone.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess fejn persuna tħoss emozzjoni u tkun commossa.

usage_examples.mt: L-emozzjonar tal-poplu kien viżibbli matul iċ-ċerimonja.
usage_examples.en: The emotional response of the people was visible during the ceremony.

definitions.text_mt: Sentiment intern qawwi bħal ferħ, dwejjaq jew rabja li bniedem iħoss (emotion).

usage_examples.mt: Esprima l-emozzjoni tiegħu b'tbissima wara r-rebħa.
usage_examples.en: He expressed his emotion with a smile after the victory.

definitions.text_mt: Pruvajt u għamilt azzjoni bl-istess mudell biex tilħaq u tqabbel suċċess ta' ħaddieħor (emulate).

usage_examples.mt: Emula s-suċċess ta meħtieġ ta' missieru fin-negozju.
usage_examples.en: He emulated his father's success in business.

definitions.text_mt: Apparat jew programm elettroniku maħsub biex jemula apparat ieħor (emulator).

usage_examples.mt: Uża emulatur biex iħaddem is-softwer antik fuq il-kompjuter l-ġdid.
usage_examples.en: He used an emulator to run the old software on the new computer.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess ta' imitazzjoni jew emulazzjoni ta' sistema oħra (emulation).

usage_examples.mt: L-emulazzjoni tal-logħba kienet taħdem perfettament.
usage_examples.en: The emulation of the game was working perfectly.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu r-rieda li jemula u li jikkompeti b'passjoni biex iqabbel suċċess.

usage_examples.mt: Spirtu emulu fl-isport li saħħaħ ir-riżultati tat-tim.
usage_examples.en: An emulous spirit in sports that strengthened the team's results.

definitions.text_mt: Kundizzjoni medika patoloġika fin-nisa li taffettwa l-organi tar-riproduzzjoni (endometriosis).

usage_examples.mt: Bata minn endometrijożi u rċeviet il-kura medika meħtieġa.
usage_examples.en: She suffered from endometriosis and received the necessary medical care.

definitions.text_mt: Kkonfermajt, iffirmajt u tajt appoġġ uffiċjali lil proġett jew kandidat (endorse).

usage_examples.mt: Endorsja l-kandidatura tiegħu quddiem il-ġurnalisti.
usage_examples.en: He endorsed his candidacy before the journalists.

definitions.text_mt: Forma femminili ta' enerġetiku jew branka li tuda l-enerġija fil-fiżika.

usage_examples.mt: Tranżizzjoni enerġetika li dwarha qed jingħata r-riżors.
usage_examples.en: An energetic transition regarding which resources are being given.

definitions.text_mt: Ix-xjenza u l-istudju dwar it-trasformazzjoni u l-użu tal-enerġija (energetics).

usage_examples.mt: L-enerġetika hija parti ewlenija mill-istudji tal-inġinerija.
usage_examples.en: Energetics is a main part of engineering studies.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew sistema mimlija saħħa, enerġija u dinamiżmu (energetic).

usage_examples.mt: Kien tmexxija enerġetika li ġabet riżultati pożittivi.
usage_examples.en: It was an energetic leadership that brought positive results.

definitions.text_mt: Il-kapacità, is-saħħa u l-forza fiżika jew elettrika biex twettaq xogħol (energy).

usage_examples.mt: L-enerġija solari tintuża biex tiġġenera l-elettriku fid-djar.
usage_examples.en: Solar energy is used to generate electricity in homes.

definitions.text_mt: B'ħafna enerġija, vitalità u sforz fiżiku (energetically).

usage_examples.mt: Ħadem enerġikament matul il-ġurnata kollha.
usage_examples.en: He worked energetically throughout the entire day.

definitions.text_mt: Mimli enerġija u vitalità, enerġetiku.

usage_examples.mt: Kien diskors enerġiku li qajjem l-entużjażmu.
usage_examples.en: It was an energetic speech that raised enthusiasm.

definitions.text_mt: Tajt u pprovdejt enerġija, entużjażmu jew forza elettrika (energize).

usage_examples.mt: Enerġizza lit-tim u qajjem l-entużjażmu tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: He energized the team and raised their enthusiasm.

definitions.text_mt: Mimli enerġija u sforz, enerġiku.

usage_examples.mt: Aġir enerġku matul il-kompetizzjoni sportiva.
usage_examples.en: Energetic conduct during the sports competition.

definitions.text_mt: Attenzjoni speċjali, importanza u tisħiħ mogħti lil punt jew diskors (emphasis).

usage_examples.mt: Għamel enfasi kbira fuq is-sigurtà fuq ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: He placed great emphasis on safety at work.

definitions.text_mt: Spjegajt u tajt importanza u enfasi speċjali dwar punt uffiċjali (emphasize).

usage_examples.mt: Enfasizza l-ħtieġa ta' edukazzjoni aħjar fir-reġjun.
usage_examples.en: He emphasized the need for better education in the region.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod fermi, ċar u bl-enfasi sħiħa f'diskors (emphatically).

usage_examples.mt: Nega l-akkużi kollha enfatikament quddiem l-istampa.
usage_examples.en: He emphatically denied all accusations before the press.

definitions.text_mt: Sentenza jew rimarka sod li tagħti enfasi ċara bla dubju (emphatic).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet tweġiba enfatika li ma ħalliet l-ebda dubju.
usage_examples.en: It was an emphatic answer that left no doubt.

definitions.text_mt: Sentenza jew rimarka sod li tagħti enfasi ċara bla dubju (emphatic).

usage_examples.mt: Ton enfatku użat fil-preżentazzjoni tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: An emphatic tone used in his presentation.

definitions.text_mt: Kbir immens f'daqs, f'ammont jew f'valur, giganti (enormous / huge).

usage_examples.mt: Bini enormi li kien jidher minn kilometri 'l bogħod.
usage_examples.en: An enormous building that was visible from kilometres away.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li għandha interess u entużjażmu kbir dwar passatemp jew arti (enthusiast).

usage_examples.mt: L-entużjasta tal-fotografija rreġistra bosta ritratti.
usage_examples.en: The photography enthusiast recorded many photos.

definitions.text_mt: B'entużjażmu u b'ferħ kbir matul azzjoni (enthusiastically).

usage_examples.mt: Il-folla ltaqgħet entużjastikament mal-vittur tal-konkors.
usage_examples.en: The crowd met enthusiastically with the contest winner.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew udjenza mimlija entużjażmu u ferħ dwar proġett (enthusiastic).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet rispons entużjastiku mir-residenti kollha.
usage_examples.en: It was an enthusiastic response from all residents.

definitions.text_en: to excite, to arouse enthusiasm, to thrill
definitions.text_mt: Qajjimt ferħ u entużjażmu kbir f'moħħ ta' xi ħadd (excite / thrill).

usage_examples.mt: L-aħbar entużjażmat lit-tfal kollha fl-iskola.
usage_examples.en: The news thrilled all the children at school.

definitions.text_mt: Sentiment ta' ferħ, interess qawwi u azzjoni b'passjoni (enthusiasm).

usage_examples.mt: Wera entużjażmu kbir għax-xogħol il-ġdid tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He showed great enthusiasm for his new job.

definitions.text_mt: Mktabt u rreġistrajt l-oġġetti jew il-fatti kollha f'lista ordnata (enumerate).

usage_examples.mt: Enumera l-benefiċċji kollha tal-proġett nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: He enumerated all benefits of the national project.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ħaddiem uffiċjali li jiġbor u jgħodd d-data jew ir-reġistrazzjoni (enumerator).

usage_examples.mt: L-enumeratur żar id-djar biex jiġbor ir-riżultati taċ-ċensiment.
usage_examples.en: The enumerator visited houses to collect census results.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess ta' għadd u reġistrazzjoni f'lista (enumeration).

usage_examples.mt: L-enumerazzjoni tal-voti ħadet diversi siegħat.
usage_examples.en: The enumeration of votes took several hours.

definitions.text_mt: Ppronunċjajt u spjegajt il-kliem bi pronunzja ċara u miftuħa (enunciate).

usage_examples.mt: Enunzja kull kelma bil-mod biex jifhmuh ilkoll.
usage_examples.en: He enunciated every word slowly so everyone would understand him.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tesprimi u tippronunċja l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet b'mod ċar (enunciator).

usage_examples.mt: L-enunzjatur tal-proposta spjega l-punti kollha.
usage_examples.en: The enunciator of the proposal explained all points.

definitions.text_mt: Il-kwalità ta' pronunzja ċara fid-diskors (enunciation).

usage_examples.mt: L-enunzjazzjoni tiegħu matul id-diskors kienet eċċellenti.
usage_examples.en: His enunciation during the speech was excellent.

definitions.text_mt: Ktieb jew sett ta' kotba li jkun fihom artikli dwar l-oqsma kollha tal-għarfien (encyclopedia).

usage_examples.mt: Fittex l-artiklu dwar l-istorja fl-enċiklopedija.
usage_examples.en: He looked up the history article in the encyclopedia.

definitions.text_mt: Branka tal-filosofija li tuda n-natura, l-oriġini u l-limiti tal-għarfien (epistemology).

usage_examples.mt: L-epistemoloġija ittrattat il-mistoqsija dwar kif nkunu nafu l-verità.
usage_examples.en: Epistemology treated the question of how we know the truth.

definitions.text_mt: L-eżempju u r-rappreżentazzjoni perfetta ta' kwalità jew status (epitome).

usage_examples.mt: Huwa kien l-epitome tal-onestà u l-lealtà.
usage_examples.en: He was the epitome of honesty and loyalty.

definitions.text_mt: Rappreżentajt u servejt bħala l-eżempju perfett ta' kwalità (epitomize).

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xogħol tiegħu epitomizza d-dedikazzjoni u s-sengħa.
usage_examples.en: His work epitomized dedication and craftsmanship.

definitions.text_mt: Figura ġeometrika pjana b'seba' angoli u seba' ġnub (heptagon).

usage_examples.mt: Pinġa eptagonu regolari fil-lezzjoni tal-ġeometrija.
usage_examples.en: He drew a regular heptagon in the geometry lesson.

definitions.text_en: height, the worst or severest period (of something)
definitions.text_mt: L-aktar punt għoli, iebes u intensiv ta meħtieġ ta' periklu, sħana jew marda.

usage_examples.mt: Fl-eqqel tas-sajf it-temperaturi jilħqu l-ogħla livell.
usage_examples.en: In the height of summer temperatures reach the highest level.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 400.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' mija u sittin membru attendew għal-laqgħa ġenerali.
usage_examples.en: Four hundred and sixty members attended the general meeting.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 4,000.

usage_examples.mt: Attendu erbat elef spettatur fil-grawnd.
usage_examples.en: Four thousand spectators attended at the stadium.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd u numru li jiġi wara tlettax u qabel ħamstax (14).

usage_examples.mt: Erbatax-il mistieden inġabru madwar il-mejda tal-festa.
usage_examples.en: Fourteen guests gathered around the party table.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 14,000.

usage_examples.mt: Investew erbatax-il elf ewro fil-proġett lokali.
usage_examples.en: They invested fourteen thousand euros in the local project.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 94.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' u disgħin sena ta' storja fil-klabb.
usage_examples.en: Ninety-four years of history in the club.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 44.

usage_examples.mt: Ergbu erbgħa u erbgħin vot favur il-mozzjoni fil-parlament.
usage_examples.en: Forty-four votes were recorded in favor of the motion in parliament.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 24.

usage_examples.mt: Biegħu erbgħa u għoxrin biljetta fl-ewwel siegħa.
usage_examples.en: They sold twenty-four tickets in the first hour.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 74.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' u sebgħin resident irċevew ir-rigal.
usage_examples.en: Seventy-four residents received the gift.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 64.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' u sittin persuna kienu fuq il-vapur.
usage_examples.en: Sixty-four people were on the ship.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 34.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' u tletin pjanċa kienu magħmula mill-injam.
usage_examples.en: Thirty-four plates were made of wood.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 84.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' u tmenin sena ta' impenn fil-komunità.
usage_examples.en: Eighty-four years of commitment in the community.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li huwa ppreżentat minn 54.

usage_examples.mt: Erba' u ħamsin marzju fit-tieni sessjoni.
usage_examples.en: Fifty-four marks in the second session.

definitions.text_mt: Element kimiku metalliku radjoattiv b'simbolu Er u numru atomiku 68.

usage_examples.mt: L-erbju jintuża fl-aloga u fit-teknoloġija tal-lejżer.
usage_examples.en: Erbium is used in alloys and laser technology.

definitions.text_mt: Li jinsab f'post Wieqaf dritt u maħsub vertikalment (erect).

usage_examples.mt: Zamm pożizzjoni eretta matul il-marċ militari.
usage_examples.en: He maintained an erect position during the military march.

definitions.text_mt: Il-bini u l-kostruzzjoni uffiċjali ta' monument jew bini (erection).
L-istat fiżiku fejn parti tal-ġisem issir iebsa bil-kurrent tad-demm.

usage_examples.mt: L-erezzjoni tal-monument saret bil-kontribuzzjoni nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: The erection of the monument took place with national contributions.

definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant fuq il-Baħar l-Aħmar (Istat tal-Eritrea).

usage_examples.mt: Asmara hija l-kapitali tal-Eritrea.
usage_examples.en: Asmara is the capital of Eritrea.

definitions.text_mt: Kundizzjoni medika fejn parti mill-organi interni toħroġ mir-rotta (hernia).

usage_examples.mt: Kien jeħtieġ operazzjoni biex jikkura l-ernja.
usage_examples.en: He required an operation to treat the hernia.

definitions.text_mt: Kuraġġ immens u attitudni ta' eroj f'periklu jew f'gwerra (heroism).

usage_examples.mt: L-eroiżmu tas-suldat kien onorat mill-president.
usage_examples.en: The soldier's heroism was honoured by the president.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna magħrufa għall-kuraġġ kbir tagħha u s-sagrifiċċju li għamlet b'unur (hero).

usage_examples.mt: Kien meqjus bħala eroj nazzjonali wara r-rebħa.
usage_examples.en: He was considered a national hero after the victory.

definitions.text_mt: Mara u eroj magħrufa għall-kuraġġ tagħha (heroine).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet l-erojina tar-rakkont li salvat r-raħal.
usage_examples.en: She was the heroine of the story who saved the village.

definitions.text_mt: Sustanza u droga illegali b'effett viċjuż u b'saħħtu.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet l-erojina tar-rakkont li salvat r-raħal.
usage_examples.en: She was the heroine of the story who saved the village.

definitions.text_mt: B'kuraġġ kbir u b'mod erojku quddiem il-periklu (heroically).

usage_examples.mt: Ġġieled erojkament biex jipproteġi l-familja tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He fought heroically to protect his family.

definitions.text_mt: Stil ta' kitba poetika jew teatrali li tgħaqqad it-trattament nobbli ma' suġġetti komiċi.

usage_examples.mt: Poema erojkomika li stabbiliet daħqa kbira fl-udjenza.
usage_examples.en: A mock-heroic poem that established great laughter in the audience.

definitions.text_mt: Stil poetiku satiriku dwar suġġett nobbli, erojkomiku.

usage_examples.mt: Stil erojkosatiriku użat mill-poeta fit-test tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: A mock-heroic satirical style used by the poet in his text.

definitions.text_mt: Għemil jew karattru mimli kuraġġ u unur sbieħ (heroic).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet mossa erojka li salvat il-ħajjiet tan-nies.
usage_examples.en: It was a heroic move that saved people's lives.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu r-relazzjoni mas-senswalità u mal-passjoni emozzjonali (erotic).

usage_examples.mt: Stil erotiku fl-istudji tal-arti klassika.
usage_examples.en: An erotic style in classical art studies.

definitions.text_mt: Kundizzjoni psikoloġika fejn persuna temmen li oħrajn jinsabu maħbubin magħha.

usage_examples.mt: L-erotomanija kienet ittrattata f'sessjonijiet ta' terapija.
usage_examples.en: Erotomania was treated in therapy sessions.

definitions.text_mt: Aġir jew moviment li mhuwiex stabbli u li jbiddel ir-rotta kontinwament (erratic).

usage_examples.mt: Moviment erratiku tal-vettura fit-triq kien ikkawżat mix-xita.
usage_examples.en: Erratic movement of the vehicle on the road was caused by rain.

definitions.text_mt: Baqra żgħira u żgħażagħ li tkun trid tikber fir-razzett (heifer).

usage_examples.mt: L-erħa kienet miexja mar-razzett mal-baqar l-oħra.
usage_examples.en: The heifer was walking in the farm with the other cows.

definitions.text_mt: Zidt u firxejt u għamilt stqarrija tkun akbar jew aktar grav mill-fatti reali (exaggerate).
Jagħmel azzjoni relatata ma' to be fussy about.

usage_examples.mt: Esaġera d-dettalji meta kien qed jirrakkontaha lill-amministrazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He exaggerated the details when he was telling it to the administration.

definitions.text_mt: Fatt jew numru li zied fl-ammont b'mod li mhux reali (exaggerated).
Li għandu proprjetà jew kwalità ta' fussy.

usage_examples.mt: Stqarrija esaġerata li ma kellha l-ebda bażi reali.
usage_examples.en: An exaggerated statement that had no real basis.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod li jaqbeż kull limitu raġonevoli, eċċessivament.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod esaġerat u billi żżid mill-ammont u mir-realtà (exaggeratedly).

usage_examples.mt: Iddeskriva l-esperjenza esaġeratament quddiem sħabu.
usage_examples.en: He described the experience exaggeratedly before his friends.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess fejn stqarrija ssir b'ammonti akbar mir-realtà (exaggeration).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet esaġerazzjoni li ma stabbilietx fiduċja fil-kummenti tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: It was an exaggeration that didn't establish trust in his comments.

definitions.text_mt: Ppreżentajt u wrajt oġġett jew dokumentazzjoni uffiċjali, esiba.

usage_examples.mt: Esiba d-dokumenti fil-qorti quddiem l-imħallef.
usage_examples.en: He exhibited the documents in court before the judge.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew kumpanija li turi l-prodotti tagħha f'fiera (exhibitor).

usage_examples.en: The exhibitor presented the new vehicles at the fair.

definitions.text_mt: Ppreżentajt u wrajt oġġett jew dokumentazzjoni uffiċjali, esiba.
Jagħmel azzjoni relatata ma' to submit to trial.

usage_examples.mt: Esibixxa r-ritratti fid-mużew lokali.
usage_examples.en: He exhibited the photos in the local museum.

definitions.text_mt: Wiri, fiera u adunanza pubblika fejn juru xogħlijiet tal-arti jew teknoloġija (exhibition).

usage_examples.mt: Attendew għall-esibizzjoni tal-pittura fil-belt.
usage_examples.en: They attended the painting exhibition in the city.

usage_examples.en: The exhibitionist was known for his remarks.

definitions.text_mt: It-tendenza li tuża azzjonijiet u aġir biex tattira l-attenzjoni fil-pubbliku.

usage_examples.mt: L-esibizzjoniżmu tiegħu nstab diżgustanti mill-udjenza.
usage_examples.en: His exhibitionism was found disgusting by the audience.

definitions.text_mt: Neħħejt u sseparajt uffiċjalment saċerdot mid-djoċesi tiegħu (excardinate).

usage_examples.mt: Eskardina s-saċerdot bil-permess tal-isqof.
usage_examples.en: He excardinated the priest with the bishop's permission.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess uffiċjali ta' tneħħija minn djoċesi (excardination).

usage_examples.mt: L-eskardinazzjoni kienet ikkonfermata mit-tribunal.
usage_examples.en: The excardination was confirmed by the tribunal.

definitions.text_mt: Għajjatt u stqarr b'emozzjoni u sorpriża f'diskors (exclaim).

usage_examples.mt: Esklama minnufih hekk kif ra r-riżultat minn fuq il-bord.
usage_examples.en: He exclaimed right away as he saw the result on the board.

definitions.text_mt: Sentenza jew rimarka li turi sorpriża u emozzjoni f'diskors (exclamatory).

usage_examples.mt: Sentenza esklamattiva li ntużat fil-poeżija.
usage_examples.en: An exclamatory sentence used in the poem.

definitions.text_mt: Stqarrija viva voce ta' sorpriża u emozzjoni qawwija (exclamation).

usage_examples.mt: Għamel esklamazzjoni ta' ferħ meta rċieva l-aħbar.
usage_examples.en: He made an exclamation of joy when he received the news.

definitions.text_mt: Neħħejt u żammejt oġġett jew persuna barra minn parteċipazzjoni (exclude).

usage_examples.mt: Eskluda d-dubji kollha wara l-verifika tar-riżultati.
usage_examples.en: He excluded all doubts after checking the results.

definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni għal persuna jew uffiċċju wieħed biss u mhux għall-kulħadd (exclusive).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet intervista esklużiva li nħarġet fil-ġurnal.
usage_examples.en: It was an exclusive interview released in the newspaper.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod li juża u japplika għal din il-parti waħdanija biss (exclusively).

usage_examples.en: The project was funded exclusively by government funds.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew kumpanija li għandha dritt uffiċjali esklużiv fuq prodott (patentee).

usage_examples.en: The patentee presented the patent regarding the new product.

definitions.text_mt: Il-kwalità u d-dritt legali li tkun l-uniku rappreżentanti minn prodott (exclusivity).

usage_examples.mt: Kiseb l-esklużività tal-bejgħ għar-reġjun kollu.
usage_examples.en: He obtained sales exclusivity for the whole region.

usage_examples.mt: L-esklużjoni tagħhom mil-kumitat nstabet mhux ġusta.
usage_examples.en: Their exclusion from the committee was found unfair.

definitions.text_mt: Kbart, kiber u firxejt u żidt il-kobor jew il-konfini ta' negozju (expand).

usage_examples.mt: Espanda n-negozju tiegħu f'pajjiżi oħra tal-Ewropa.
usage_examples.en: He expanded his business to other countries in Europe.

usage_examples.en: The expansion of the port permits larger ships.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu r-rieda u r-riżorsi biex jikber u jifrex fl-ambjent (expansive).

usage_examples.mt: Kultura espansiva li bniet relazzjonijiet internazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: An expansive culture that built international relations.

definitions.text_mt: It-tkabbir, it-tferrix u l-estenzjoni f'żona wiesgħa (expansion).

usage_examples.en: The expansion of the city brought a larger demand for transport.

definitions.text_mt: L-għarfien u l-ħiliet miksuba maż-żmien minn prattika fil-ħajja (experience).

usage_examples.en: Expressionism was a popular style in the early 20th century.

usage_examples.en: He was in great ecstasy as he heard the beautiful music.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew spirtu mimli ferħ immens u eċċitament (ecstatic).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet udjenza estatika li sellmet lill-artisti.
usage_examples.en: It was an ecstatic audience that greeted the artists.

definitions.text_mt: Qtajt, neħħejt u qrist sħiħ mill-għeruq oġġett jew marda (extirpate).

usage_examples.en: He extirpated the bad plants from the garden.

definitions.text_mt: Ta' kwalità eċċezzjonali, sbieħ u ta' livell għoli ħafna (excellent).

usage_examples.mt: Servizz eċċellenti li kien apprezzat mill-klijenti kollha.
usage_examples.en: An excellent service that was appreciated by all clients.

definitions.text_mt: Il-kwalità u l-grad ta' livell għoli ħafna f'xogħol (excellence).

usage_examples.mt: Kiseb il-premju tal-eċċellenza fil-qasam tat-teknoloġija.
usage_examples.en: He obtained the award of excellence in the field of technology.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna b'aġir jew manjieri strambi u differenti mil-normal (eccentric).

usage_examples.mt: Kien raġel eċċentriku li kien jgħix waħdu fil-muntanji.
usage_examples.en: He was an eccentric man who lived alone in the mountains.

etymology_chain.definition: to object (that), to raise (an objection) ( to something or someone )

definitions.text_en: to except (to take exception, to object to)
definitions.text_mt: Għamilt oġġezzjoni f'qorti bil-miktub, eċċepa.

usage_examples.mt: Eċċepa kontra d-deċiżjoni u bagħat appell uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: He took exception against the decision and sent an official appeal.

definitions.text_mt: Argoment jew azzjoni li tista' tiġi opposta f'qorti (objectionable).

usage_examples.mt: Punt eċċepibbli fir-rapport tal-prosekuzzjoni.
usage_examples.en: An objectionable point in the prosecution report.

etymology_chain.definition: to object (that), to raise (an objection) ( to something or someone )

definitions.text_en: to except (to take exception, to object to)
definitions.text_mt: Għamilt oġġezzjoni f'qorti bil-miktub, eċċepa.

usage_examples.mt: Eċċepixxa quddiem il-bord dwar ir-regoli.
usage_examples.en: He took exception before the board regarding the rules.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont kbir li jaqbeż dak li huwa meħtieġ jew b'saħħtu (excess).

usage_examples.mt: L-eċċess ta' spejjeż ġab diffikultajiet finanzjarji.
usage_examples.en: The excess of expenses brought financial difficulties.

definitions.text_mt: Li jaqbeż kull limitu raġonevoli fit-tul jew fl-ammont (excessive).

usage_examples.mt: Użu eċċessiv tal-ilma fit-tindif li kien jaħli.
usage_examples.en: Excessive use of water in cleaning that was wasteful.

etymology_chain.definition: et cetera, and so on, and so forth

definitions.text_en: et cetera, and so on, and so forth
definitions.text_mt: Espressjoni użata biex tindika li hemm aktar oġġetti simili fil-lista (and so on).

usage_examples.mt: Xtraw tuffieħ, larinġ, lanġas u eċċetra.
usage_examples.en: They bought apples, oranges, pears, and so on.

definitions.text_mt: Eskludejt u żammejt persuna jew oġġett barra mir-regola (except).

usage_examples.mt: Eċċettwa lil min kien b'marda mir-regola l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: He excepted those who were ill from the new rule.

definitions.text_mt: Li mhuwiex komuni u li għandu talent jew livell rari u sbieħ (exceptional).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet prestazzjoni eċċezzjonali li rċeviet applawsi sħaħ.
usage_examples.en: It was an exceptional performance that received full applause.

definitions.text_mt: Il-kwalità u r-rarità ta' min ikun eċċezzjonali (exceptionality).

usage_examples.mt: L-eċċezzjonalità tax-xogħol tiegħu kinetx magħrufa minn kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: The exceptionality of his work was known to everyone.

definitions.text_mt: Fattur jew każ speċjali li ma jsegwix ir-regola ġenerali (exception).
Oġġezzjoni uffiċjali magħmula f'proċess legali (objection).

usage_examples.mt: Għamlu eċċezzjoni għal dan il-każ minħabba l-emerġenza.
usage_examples.en: They made an exception for this case due to the emergency.

definitions.text_mt: Qbeżt il-limitu, eċċeda.

usage_examples.mt: Eċċieda l-ammont stabbilit fil-baġit.
usage_examples.en: He exceeded the amount established in the budget.

definitions.text_mt: Qajjimt entużjażmu u emozzjoni kbira f'moħħ jew f'qalb (excite).

usage_examples.mt: L-aħbar eċċitat lit-tfal kollha qabel il-festa.
usage_examples.en: The news excited all the children before the feast.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li mil-faċli li ssir emozzjonata jew eċċitata (excitable).

usage_examples.mt: Kien tifel eċċitabbli li kien jaqbeż mill-ferħ.
usage_examples.en: He was an excitable child who jumped for joy.

definitions.text_mt: Stat ta' ferħ, emozzjoni qawwija u stennija entużjasta (excitement).

usage_examples.mt: L-eċċitament fil-folla kien wieħed kbir qabel it-tluq tal-utritti.
usage_examples.en: The excitement in the crowd was immense before the race start.

definitions.text_mt: Avveniment jew film li jġib eċċitament u ferħ (exciting).

usage_examples.mt: Kienet partita eċċitanti li ntemmet bil-penaltis.
usage_examples.en: It was an exciting match that ended with penalties.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess ta' qawmien ta' enerġija u emozzjonijiet (excitation).

usage_examples.mt: L-eċċitazzjoni fil-folla kinetx viżibbli f'kull kantuniera.
usage_examples.en: Excitation in the crowd was visible in every corner.

etymology_chain.definition: Egypt (a country in North Africa and West Asia )
Ancient Egypt ( a civilization that existed in the valley of the Nile River from c. 3150 BCE to 30 BCE )
the Aegyptus river, i.e. the Nile River

definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq u l-Asja tal-Punent (Repubblika Għarbija tal-Eġittu).

usage_examples.mt: Il-Kajru hija l-kapitali tal-Eġittu.
usage_examples.en: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

definitions.text_en: Egyptian (of, from or relating to Egypt)
definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni jew ikun relatat mal-pajjiż u l-kultura tal-Eġittu (Egyptian).

usage_examples.mt: Storja Eġizzjana antika li tuda l-piramidi.
usage_examples.en: Ancient Egyptian history studying the pyramids.

definitions.text_en: Egyptian (native or inhabitant of Egypt) (usually male)
definitions.text_mt: Persuna nattiva jew resident mill-Eġittu (Egyptian person).

usage_examples.mt: L-Eġizzjan li ltqajna miegħu kien jaħdem fil-mużew.
usage_examples.en: The Egyptian we met worked in the museum.

definitions.text_mt: Forma femminili ta' Eġizzjan, relatata mal-Eġittu.

usage_examples.mt: Arti Eġizzjana antika ddisinjata fuq il-ħajt.
usage_examples.en: Ancient Egyptian art designed on the wall.

definitions.text_mt: Mara jew ċittadina femminili mill-Eġittu.

usage_examples.mt: L-Eġizzjana ppreżentat il-kultura tradizzjonali tagħha.
usage_examples.en: The Egyptian woman presented her traditional culture.

definitions.text_en: synonym of iva: yes, yep, yeah
definitions.text_mt: Interjezzjoni u kelma kolloqjali fil-Malti li tfisser 'iva' u tintuża biex taqbel (yes).

usage_examples.mt: Qal 'eħe' hekk kif saqsiewh jekk kienx se jiġi magħhom.
usage_examples.en: He said 'yes' as they asked him if he was coming with them.

definitions.text_mt: Figura ġeometrika pjana b'sitt angoli u sitt ġnub (hexagon).

usage_examples.mt: Pinġa eżagonu fuq il-karta matul il-lezzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He drew a hexagon on paper during the lesson.

definitions.text_mt: Test u proċess uffiċjali ta' evalwazzjoni tal-għarfien tal-istudenti fl-iskola (exam).
Ħaġa jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal test.

usage_examples.mt: Għamel l-eżami tal-Malti u kiseb riżultat mill-isbaħ.
usage_examples.en: He sat for the Maltese exam and scored a wonderful result.

definitions.text_mt: Fittex, iċċekkja u analizzajt bir-reqqa apparat jew il-kundizzjoni ta' pazjent (examine).

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib eżamina lill-pazjent fil-klinika tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: The doctor examined the patient in his clinic.

definitions.text_mt: Li huwa preċiż, mingħajr ebda żball u f'dettall meħtieġ (exact / precise).

usage_examples.mt: Tah l-ammont eżatt tal-kont bil-flus.
usage_examples.en: He gave him the exact amount of the bill in cash.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod preċiż u eżattament, eżattament.

usage_examples.mt: Wasal eżatt fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: He arrived exactly at eight in the morning.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod eżatt u b'reqqa sħiħa f'kull dettall (exactly).

usage_examples.mt: Aġixxa eżattament kif kien struzzjonat mis-superjuri.
usage_examples.en: He acted exactly as instructed by superiors.

definitions.text_mt: Il-kwalità ta' preċiżjoni sħiħa mingħajr ebda żball (accuracy).

usage_examples.mt: L-eżattezza tal-arpermiment kinetx meħtieġa għar-riżultat.
usage_examples.en: The accuracy of the experiment was necessary for the result.

definitions.text_mt: Fattur jew azzjoni magħmula biex turi u tispjega regola jew mudell (example).

usage_examples.mt: Għata eżempju ċar dwar kif għandha tintuża l-magna.
usage_examples.en: He gave a clear example of how the machine should be used.

definitions.text_mt: Wettaqt sforz fiżiku jew użajt awtorità u drittijiet uffiċjali (exercise).

usage_examples.mt: Eżerċita id-dritt tiegħu li ivvota fl-elezzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He exercised his right to vote in the election.

definitions.text_mt: Attività fiżika jew kompitu akkademiku maħsub biex itejjeb l-għarfien (exercise).

usage_examples.mt: Għamel eżerċizzju ta' nofs siegħa fil-ġinnasju.
usage_examples.en: He did a half-hour exercise in the gym.

definitions.text_mt: Korp sħiħ ta' suldati u forzi armati lesta għad-difiża (army).

usage_examples.mt: L-eżerċtu pproteġa l-fruntieri tal-pajjiż b'kawtela.
usage_examples.en: The army protected the country's borders with caution.

definitions.text_mt: Kelli ħajja, preżenza u realtà fiżika fl-univers maż-żmien (exist).

usage_examples.mt: L-ispeċi eżistiet f'dawk l-inħawi għal sekli sħaħ.
usage_examples.en: The species existed in those areas for centuries.

definitions.text_mt: Li jinsab hemmhekk fir-realtà fil-mument preżenti (existent).

usage_examples.mt: Ir-regoli eżistenti għandhom jiġu segwiti minn kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: Existing rules must be followed by everyone.

definitions.text_mt: L-istat ta' tkun preżenti u r-realtà tal-ħajja (existence).

usage_examples.mt: L-eżistenza tagħha kinetx meħtieġa għas-sigurtà tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: Her existence was necessary for their safety.

definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni għall-filosofija dwar l-eżistenza u l-ħajja tal-bniedem (existential).

usage_examples.mt: Kriżi eżistenzjali li dwarha kiteb il-filosofu.
usage_examples.en: An existential crisis about which the philosopher wrote.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li temmen fid-duttrina tal-eżistenzjaliżmu (existentialist).

usage_examples.mt: L-eżistenzjalista ppreżenta l-perspettiva tiegħu dwar il-libertà.
usage_examples.en: The existentialist presented his perspective on freedom.

definitions.text_mt: Moviment filosofiku li jagħti tisħiħ dwar il-libertà u r-responsabbiltà individwali.

usage_examples.mt: L-eżistenzjaliżmu kellu impatt kbir fuq il-letteratura tas-seklu 20.
usage_examples.en: Existentialism had a great impact on 20th century literature.

etymology_chain.definition: Hebrew, of or related to the Hebrew language

definitions.text_mt: Li jappartjeni jew ikun relatat mal-poplu Lhud u l-kultura tagħhom (Hebrew).

usage_examples.mt: Test Għebrew antik miktub fuq il-pergamena.
usage_examples.en: An ancient Hebrew text written on parchment.

definitions.text_mt: Kwalità ta meħtieġ ta' oġġett iebes jew il-kwalità ta' persuna b'rimarki iebsin (hardness).

usage_examples.mt: L-ibusija tal-materjal ma ppermettiex li jinqata' faċilment.
usage_examples.en: The hardness of the material did not allow it to be cut easily.

definitions.text_mt: Stqarrija matematika fejn żewġ espressjonijiet huma ugwali bil-valur (equation).

usage_examples.mt: Solva l-kwazzjoni mal-għalliem tal-matematika.
usage_examples.en: He solved the equation with the mathematics teacher.

definitions.text_mt: Għajjatt u stqarr b'emozzjoni u sorpriża f'diskors (exclaim).

usage_examples.mt: Sklama mill-ewwel meta ra r-rigal sbieħ.
usage_examples.en: He exclaimed right away when he saw the beautiful gift.

definitions.text_mt: Neħħejt u żammejt oġġett jew persuna barra minn parteċipazzjoni (exclude).

usage_examples.mt: Skluda l-parti dwar l-ispejjeż mir-rapport.
usage_examples.en: He excluded the section about costs from the report.

definitions.text_mt: Il-Ktieb Sagru fl-Kristjaneżmu li jkun fih l-ħajja u t-tagħlim ta' Ġesù (gospel).

usage_examples.mt: Il-vanġelu kien miktub fuq il-pulptu.
usage_examples.en: The gospel was written on the pulpit.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li temmen u li għandha fidi sħiħa (believer).

usage_examples.mt: Kien wemmien sod fil-fidi u fit-tradizzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He was a firm believer in faith and tradition.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li għandha fidi, emmien.

usage_examples.mt: Il-wemmieni attendew iċ-ċerimonja mas-saċerdot.
usage_examples.en: The believer attended the ceremony with the priest.

etymology_chain.definition: present active infinitive of fīdō ( “ to trust; to put confidence in ” )

definitions.text_mt: Tajt fiduċja lil xi ħadd u responsabbiltà dwar xogħol.

usage_examples.mt: Afda x-xogħol tad-dar f'idejn ħuh il-kbir.
usage_examples.en: He entrusted the household work to his older brother.

definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni li tindika post jew stat ġewwa oġġett jew spazju.

usage_examples.mt: Poġġa l-flus f'kaxxa żgħira fuq l-ixkaffa.
usage_examples.en: He placed the money inside a small box on the shelf.

definitions.text_mt: Apparat u oġġetti kollha użati fl-istudju jew fit-teatru.

usage_examples.mt: In-nazzjon dwar it-teatru pprepara l-fabbiżonju kollu għall-udjenza.
usage_examples.en: The theatre group prepared all the props for the audience.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna bi spirtu djoċesan u djalogu faċli u ferħan.

usage_examples.mt: Għalliem fabbli li kulħadd iħobb jitkellem miegħu fl-iskola.
usage_examples.en: An affable teacher whom everyone loves talking to at school.

definitions.text_mt: Bini kbir u impjant fejn jipproduċu l-oġġetti bil-makkinarju.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fabbrika l-ġdida bdiet tipproduċi l-prodotti lokali.
usage_examples.en: The new factory began producing local goods.

definitions.text_mt: Li jista' jiġi prodott u maħdum fil-fabbrika.

usage_examples.mt: Partijiet fabbrikabbli li jintbagħtu barra mill-pajjiż.
usage_examples.en: Manufacturable parts exported abroad.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew kumpanija li tmexxi l-produzzjoni fil-fabbrika.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fabbrikant uża materjal ta' kwalità għall-prodotti tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: The manufacturer used quality materials for his products.

definitions.text_mt: L-att u l-proċess fejn jibnu u jagħmlu l-oġġetti fil-fabbrika.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fabbrikazzjoni tal-karozzi ssir awtomatikament bil-makkinarju.
usage_examples.en: Car manufacturing is done automatically by machinery.

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal fabbrika.

usage_examples.mt: Jaħdem f'fabrika ta' tessuti fil-Qormi.
usage_examples.en: He works in a textile factory in Qormi.

etymology_chain.definition: present active infinitive of fīdō ( “ to trust; to put confidence in ” )

definitions.text_mt: Forma tradizzjonali li tfisser afda lil xi ħadd.

usage_examples.mt: Fada d-dokumenti importanti f'idejn in-nutar.
usage_examples.en: He entrusted the important documents to the notary.

etymology_chain.definition: inflection of offōcō: present active infinitive second-person singular present passive imperative / indicative

definitions.text_mt: Għamilt dwejjaq fil-gerżuma minħabba nuqqas ta' arja jew xogħol.

usage_examples.mt: Malti faga bid-duħħan fit-triq u ma stax jieħu n-nifs.
usage_examples.en: The smoke choked him on the street and he couldn't breathe.

definitions.text_mt: Pakkett żgħir jew għodda tradizzjonali militari.

usage_examples.mt: Ġarr fagozz żgħir fl-ingwanta qabel l-avventuri tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He carried a small bundle under his arm before his adventures.

definitions.text_mt: Tfajt u għidt b'qawwa diskors jew mistoqsijiet mingħajr bżonn.

usage_examples.mt: Fajjar daqqa ta' ponn lejn il-ħajt meta rrabja.
usage_examples.en: He threw a punch at the wall when he got angry.

definitions.text_mt: Dokument dijitali u borża jew kaxxa użata biex iżżomm d-dokumenti.

usage_examples.mt: Fetaħ il-fajl fuq il-kompjuter biex jaqra r-rapport.
usage_examples.en: He opened the file on the computer to read the report.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tġorr il-kaxxi u l-merkanzija fil-port jew mas-suq.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fakkin ġarr il-kaxxi kollha mir-romblu għall-vapur.
usage_examples.en: The porter carried all the boxes from the quay to the ship.

etymology_chain.definition: an individual employed to do all sorts of duties

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tagħmel u tieħu ħsieb kull tip ta' xogħol fl-uffiċċju.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa l-faktotu tal-iskola li jsewwi kollox fis-sala.
usage_examples.en: He is the school factotum who fixes everything in the hall.

etymology_chain.definition: an individual employed to do all sorts of duties

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal faktotu.

usage_examples.mt: Jaħdem bħala faktotum u jieħu ħsieb ir-reception u l-tindif.
usage_examples.en: He works as a factotum taking care of reception and cleaning.

definitions.text_mt: Dipartiment fl-università; jew il-kapaċità mentali ta' persuna.

usage_examples.mt: Studja fit-Taqsima u fil-Fakultà tal-Arti fl-Università ta' Malta.
usage_examples.en: He studied in the Faculty of Arts at the University of Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Speċi ta' għasfur tal-priża żgħir mill-familja Falconidae.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falkett intlemaħ itir fuq l-irdumijiet ta' Dingli.
usage_examples.en: The Eurasian hobby falcon was spotted flying over the Dingli cliffs.

definitions.text_mt: Għasfur tal-priża veloċi ħafna magħruf f'Malta storikament.

usage_examples.mt: Il-Falkun Malti għandu post storiku fil-kultura tagħna.
usage_examples.en: The Maltese Falcon has a historical place in our culture.

definitions.text_en: to fail, to be absent, go bankrupt
definitions.text_mt: Ma rnexxejtx fl-eżami jew ma ġejtx fis-servizz.

usage_examples.mt: Kumpanija falliet wara li telfet il-klijenti kollha tagħha.
usage_examples.en: The company went bankrupt after losing all its clients.

definitions.text_mt: Diskors u argumentazzjoni li għandha żball moħbi.

usage_examples.mt: L-argument tiegħu kien fallazi u ma kienx konvinċenti.
usage_examples.en: His argument was fallacious and unconvincing.

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal fallaz.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falsarju ppruva jbiegħ il-pittura falza fl-irkanti.
usage_examples.en: The forger tried to sell the fake painting at the auction.

definitions.text_mt: L-att fejn tiffalsifika dokument jew sinjal.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falsifikament tad-dokumenti rriżulta f'każ il-Qorti.
usage_examples.en: The falsification of documents resulted in a court case.

definitions.text_mt: Forma u proċess fejn tagħmel u taqbad oġġett falz.

usage_examples.mt: Instabu bosta falsifikazzjonijiet ta' flus fl-investigazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: Several money forgeries were found in the investigation.

definitions.text_mt: Nuqqas ta' onestà u mġiba fejn tqarraq bl-oħrajn.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falsità tiegħu kienet tidher mill-ewwel mument fid-diskors.
usage_examples.en: His hypocrisy was evident from the very first moment in the speech.

definitions.text_mt: Li mhuwiex veru u li nħoloq biex iqarraq.

usage_examples.mt: Uża passaport falz biex jaqsam il-fruntiera.
usage_examples.en: He used a fake passport to cross the border.

definitions.text_mt: Adverbju li jindika azzjoni ssir b'mod mhux veru.

usage_examples.mt: Akkużawh falzament li seraq il-karozza mill-garaxx.
usage_examples.en: They falsely accused him of stealing the car from the garage.

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal falsarju.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falzarju sab ruħu arrestat mill-pulizija.
usage_examples.en: The forger found himself arrested by the police.

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal fallaz.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falzatur rċieva sentenza ta' tliet snin priġunerija.
usage_examples.en: The forger received a three-year prison sentence.

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal falsifikazzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falzifikazzjoni tal-passaport kienet waħda professjonali.
usage_examples.en: The passport falsification was professional.

definitions.text_mt: Forma alternattiva għal falsità.

usage_examples.mt: Ma stax jissaporti l-falzità fid-relazzjonijiet tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He could not stand hypocrisy in his relationships.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tappoġġja u tagħti prijorità lill-familja tagħha.

usage_examples.mt: Kien familista li jagħmel minn kollox għall-ulied tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He was a family-oriented person who did everything for his children.

definitions.text_mt: Grupp ta' nies imqabbdin b'rabta ta' demm, żwieġ jew adozzjoni użati li jgħixu flimkien.

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja kollha inġabret madwar il-mejda għall-ikla tal-Ħadd.
usage_examples.en: The whole family gathered around the table for Sunday lunch.

definitions.text_mt: Oġġett jew wiċċ li diġà tafu sew mill-passat.
